meta.name: mem-search
meta.description: Use this when the user asks to search memory, "did we already solve this?", "how did we do X last time?", or wants work from previous sessions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 快速找回之前会话中解决过的问题和做法
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你常想从过往对话里快速找回答案。
copy.tagline_en: Recall past solutions and how you did things before.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to dig up answers from earlier conversations.

howto.what: 装上后,当你问起以前会话做过的事,Claude 会先在记忆库搜出带编号的条目列表(含标题/时间等),再挑相关条目查看时间线,最后只对选中的编号批量取完整记录。
howto.when: 当你说要搜索记忆,或问“是不是已经解决过”“上次怎么做的”,或需要之前会话的工作记录时,Claude 会调用本技能。

say.text: 这个登录报错我们以前解决过吗?
say.note: Claude 会搜索历史记录来回答。

say.text: 上次我们是怎么修登录超时问题的?
say.note: 按关键词搜出相关修复记录。

say.text: 上周在这个项目里遇到过哪些 bug?
say.note: 按 bugfix 类型搜最近记录。

howto.what_en: After installation, when you ask about previous sessions, Claude searches the memory database for a numbered list of matching entries, examines timeline context around relevant ones, then fetches full details only for the chosen IDs.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to search memory, asks “did we already solve this?”, “how did we do X last time?”, or wants work from previous sessions.

say_en.text: Have we ever fixed this login error before?
How did we fix the login timeout last time?
What bugs did we hit in this project last week?
say_en.note: Searches recent records filtered by bugfix type.
